Management anticipates that these cost reductions will contribute favorably to gross margins in future periods as the benefits are realized, although the actual impact will depend on sales volumes and product mix.
We expect our sales and marketing expenses to continue to increase as we seek to build our customer base and launch additional products.
Future R&D expenditures will be evaluated in relation to commercial opportunities, operational priorities, and the Company’s objective of achieving sustainable profitability.
The continued growth of the Company’s Integrated Service Program and investment in its technology platform are expected to support greater operating leverage as revenues increase.

Management intends to maintain a disciplined approach to expenditures, prioritizing investments in technology, customer acquisition, and commercialization activities that support revenue growth and improved financial performance.
Management will continue to evaluate opportunities to strengthen liquidity and capital resources while maintaining a disciplined approach to operating expenditures and long-term growth initiatives.
Management expects working capital requirements to fluctuate with changes in revenue, customer billing and collection cycles, and the timing of operating expenditures.
Management intends to prioritize funding operations through internally generated cash flows and the collection of outstanding receivables while maintaining a disciplined approach to expenditures.

Although management believes that revenue growth, improved cost management, and anticipated collections of outstanding receivables may support future operating requirements, the Company has not yet demonstrated sustained positive operating cash flows.

Management will continue to evaluate available financing alternatives based on the Company’s liquidity requirements, anticipated operating cash flows, financing costs, and the interests of its shareholders.
